notes: Widened from the nine-function dMg3DEspAnimSet_c span 0x020e777c..0x020e7b0c to the whole unit, which also holds dScMg3DEsp_c and dMg3DEspModel_c. The manifest id and the path stay dMg3DEspAnimSet_c's, the smaller change: renaming the TU after dScMg3DEsp_c would re-key the nine existing attribution and converted-baseline entries and the queue row as well. The folded files were dScMg3DEsp_c's D1 and D0, dMg3DEspModel_c's seven members, the 43 helpers from func_ov006_020e7cc0 to func_ov006_020e9bbc, and dScMg3DEsp_c's Virtual50, OnYoshiTryEat, CleanupResources, Render, Behavior and InitResources files; attribution.json keeps each one's credit through a path#symbol override.

Written ROM-ASCENDING because `#pragma defer_codegen off` makes CodeWarrior emit each definition as it is encountered rather than in reverse source order. With dScMg3DEsp_c's out-of-line destructor first in the file it emits D1 and D0 at ordinals 0 and 1; the homeless D2s and C2s of the three classes are dispositioned deadstrip.

Pragma brackets carry each retired file's file-global pragma around its own function: opt_strength_reduction off around the nine dMg3DEspAnimSet_c members (the previous TU's file-global) and func_ov006_020e8aac, opt_common_subs off around func_ov006_020e84b8 (with opt_strength_reduction off), _020e85f0, _020e8728, _020e8830 and _020e8928.

The file does not include decl_common.h, which declares the file handles and data_ov006_0213c844 as void * and func_ov006_020e8354 as taking char *. The ten SharedFilePtr file handles are declared as SharedFilePtr here, as the retired destructor and CleanupResources files did. Helpers defined with a typed receiver (func_ov006_020e8354, _020e8a44, _020e8d08, _020e9374, _020e7f5c) are called with a cast to it. The ModelAnim::SetAnim, TextureSequence::SetFile and TextureTransformer::SetFile calls stay mangled with a scalar speed and an unsigned short last parameter.

Folding changed four spellings, all measured byte-identical: func_ov006_020e91a0 tests data_020a0de9 directly (the retired C file stored `x != 0` in an int, which in C++ is a bool conversion and costs three instructions); func_ov006_020e989c reads data_ov004_020beb68 through `char *` casts, and the one load the ROM repeats is a volatile read, because dScMgBase_c.h declares it void * and every non-volatile spelling reuses the earlier load; func_ov006_020e9b70 is void, as func_ov006_020e82fc is; and the retired files' mangled `_ZN5Sound12PlayBank2_2DEj` calls are spelled Sound::PlayBank2_2D.

Each member keeps its own legacy shadow types, suffixed with the member's address (G2_7d7c, Ent_82fc, Outer_8354, C_8a44, C_8d08, P_8e10, C_9374, C_989c, C_9b70, ...) so that the retired files' independently-invented tags coexist. The incomplete structs and PMF typedefs above the pointer-to-member dispatchers (C_8a44, C_8d08, C_9374, C_9b70) keep their order: completing a struct before its PMF typedef changes the pointer-to-member representation mwcc emits.

compiler_only_output.reason: Homeless. mwcc emits three destructor variants from the one out-of-line definition -- D1, D0, D2 -- but the cartridge carries only D1 (0x020e7660, size 0x84) and D0 (0x020e76e4), which are adjacent: 0x020e76e4 - 0x020e7660 = 0x84, exactly D1's size, so the image has no room for a D2 between them. The factory constructs the class as a leaf, so its own D2 is never odr-used. _ZN12dScMg3DEsp_cD2Ev appears in no symbols.txt and no delinks.txt anywhere in the tree, so it has no ROM home at all -- plain deadstrip, and production isolation discards it.
